mintAuthority.summary: HOLLAR is minted on the Hydration appchain by depositing DOT/ETH/BTC/stablecoin collateral into an Aave v3 (GHO-derived) money market, with the HOLLAR Stability Module anchoring the peg; Hydration governance controls collateral and risk parameters.

upgradeability.controlRef: Hydration OpenGov root track runtime upgrade origin

controls.label: Hydration Aave-v3 fork money market (minter)
controls.capDescription: HOLLAR mints only against overcollateralized positions on Hydration's Aave-v3-forked (GHO-style) money market, subject to a per-asset supply cap; the launch supply cap was 2,000,000 HOLLAR.
controls.evidence: HOLLAR mints only against overcollateralized positions on Hydration's Aave-v3-forked (GHO-style) money market pallet with a per-asset supply cap (launch cap 2,000,000 HOLLAR); Hydration governance can raise the cap, so the bound is raiseable. The pallet-backed EVM shim at 0x531a654d1696ed52e7275a8cede955e82620f99a has no proxy admin or owner().

controls.label: Hydration governance / parameter admin
controls.capDescription: Hydration governance sets collateral onboarding, risk parameters, supply caps, and the HSM configuration; HOLLAR is governed by Hydration rather than Polkadot OpenGov directly.
controls.evidence: Coverage notes HOLLAR is governed by Hydration (not DOT holders), which controls collateral rules, risk parameters, and the on-chain HOLLAR Stability Module. Hydration's pinned runtime source configures HSM AuthorityOrigin as Root, EconomicParameters, or GeneralAdmin.

controls.label: Hydration OpenGov root track runtime upgrade origin
controls.evidence: Hydration's runtime composes System, ConvictionVoting, Referenda, Origins, Whitelist, and Dispatcher, and its pinned governance configuration defines a `root` referendum track. Runtime code changes are Root-origin operations, so the root OpenGov track is the on-chain governance route that can replace the runtime minting logic. At Hydration block 13133392, state_getRuntimeVersion reported hydradx specVersion 428.

review.evidence: Hydration press and coverage describe HOLLAR as an Aave-v3/GHO-derived overcollateralized stablecoin with the native HSM for peg support, governed by Hydration with parameter-level control over collateral and caps. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: collateral-gated issuance is capped but Hydration OpenGov can raise caps and upgrade runtime logic; no off-chain reserve claim or prudential supervisor applies.
review.reviewer: Claude Phase 0c continuation; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-3 (lead usds-sky) (2026-07-20); Sol economic-posture batch 2026-08-15
review.sourceFreeRationale: Aave-v3/GHO fork mint model and Hydration governance confirmed from coverage and docs. On-chain read via Hydration EVM RPC (https://rpc.nice.hydration.cloud, block 0x14fb62 ≈ 1,375,074) showed HOLLAR at 0x531a654d1696ed52e7275a8cede955e82620f99a is a two-byte pallet-backed EVM shim with no proxy admin slot and no owner(). Hydration's pinned runtime source configures HSM AuthorityOrigin as Root, EconomicParameters, or GeneralAdmin; the runtime composes OpenGov Referenda and a root track. The current Hydration RPC at block 13133392 reported specVersion 428, confirming the runtime-governance path is the relevant mint-logic authority rather than an EVM admin key.
